policy: Do not change expected source IDs merely to match an implementation. A change requires a documented source or intent review and a new dataset version.

sourceReviews.reason: This is a factual sample-method question, not publication navigation. The maintained SMI source contains the statistical sample-study, sample-plot and national-scope passages; a route-only publication card cannot support that answer.

The query explicitly asks for national quantity and method. Its numeric lead uses the actual primary SMI 2025 workbook and a separate SMI method witness. The list says data as of 18.08.2026; no workbook publication day is inferred. Original 2024 PDF and revised 2024 row in the 2025 edition remain distinct.
